summary: Full end-to-end UI test of Admin > Catégories de chauffeurs CRUD passed. Login as admin, /admin/driver-categories renders 10 seeded categories grouped by Taxi/Coursier/Livreur, create-edit-toggle-delete flow all work, conditional sub-row visibility (only taxi+car) verified, both validation toasts (empty label / no docs) trigger, seed data integrity preserved (edited delivery_velo reverted to 'Livreur · Vélo', final count = 10).
critical_code_review_comments: Edit flow does not enforce server-side validation on missing taxi_sub when service=taxi+vehicle=car switching back from non-taxi (UI handles it but worth a backend safety check).
Toggle active sends the full cat object including 'id' in the PUT body — confirm backend ignores body 'id' to prevent accidental id rewrite.
On the editor, the doc list always renders at least one empty {key,label} row but validation only filters non-empty rows; consider hiding the empty row by default in edit mode for cleaner UX.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one test category (auto-id courier_velo_2). Briefly edited delivery_velo label and reverted to original 'Livreur · Vélo'. No persisted changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver Categories admin CRUD UI is fully functional. Test ids dc-* all present and reliable. window.confirm dialogs auto-accept via page.on('dialog'). The endpoint POST /api/admin/driver-categories auto-suffixes ids on collision (verified: produced 'courier_velo_2'). Seed list contains 10 entries: taxi_moto, taxi_car_particulier, taxi_car_vtc, taxi_car_taxi, courier_velo, courier_moto, courier_car, delivery_velo, delivery_moto, delivery_car.
